name: Sbu Docs

replaces.name: CamScanner - PDF Scanner App
replaces.price_model: Free with heavy ads; Premium subscription weekly/monthly/quarterly/annual with free trial

one_thing: Turns paper into a searchable PDF file that stays yours in the Files app.

features.name: Multi-page scan with edge detection
features.description: System document camera (VNDocumentCameraViewController): auto-capture, crop, perspective fix, several pages in one go.
features.reason: Batch scanning is paywalled in CamScanner.

features.name: PDF without watermark
features.description: Every scan saved as a PDF file in the app folder, no watermark, no page cap.
features.reason: Watermark removal and PDF save/export are paid.

features.name: Searchable text layer (OCR)
features.description: Vision text recognition (it, en, and other on-device languages) written as an invisible text layer; select and copy text.

features.name: Filters
features.description: Original, grayscale, black-and-white 'photocopy', enhanced colour; applied before saving (ADR-0006: no re-filter later).

features.name: Reorder, delete, add pages
features.description: Page grid with drag to reorder; add pages to an existing PDF by scanning more.

features.name: Merge and split PDFs
features.description: Combine documents or extract pages with PDFKit.

features.name: Folders
features.description: Folders are directories in the app folder, visible in Files.
features.reason: Moving to a folder is paywalled.

features.name: Signature
features.description: Draw a signature once (PencilKit), place it on a page; saved into the same file.
features.reason: E-signature is a paid CamScanner feature.

features.name: Share, print, Files
features.description: ShareLink, UIPrintInteractionController; documents open in place from Files.

features.name: Search
features.description: Search titles and recognised text across the archive.

features.name: No ads, no prompts, nothing to buy
features.description: No ads, no rating nags, no surveys, no paywall; nothing stands between scan and send.
features.reason: Ads (96), paywall (28), paid but not recognised (10), trial charges (5).

features.name: Export always free
features.description: Save and send as PDF or JPEG always available, including by Mail.

features.name: Files that stay yours
features.description: Plain PDF files: survive updates, appear in Files, in the iPhone backup, no migration.
features.reason: Documents lost after an update (2); ADR-0006.

features.name: Fast on old iPhones
features.description: Capture via the system camera, OCR in a background task after saving.
features.reason: Slow and crashes on iPhone XR (4).

features.name: Classic black and white
features.description: A true photocopy-style B/W filter that stays stable across versions.

features.name: Signature in the same file
features.description: Signing edits the PDF in place, no duplicate file.

features.name: Automatic title
features.description: Title from date and first recognised line; on iOS 26+ Foundation Models proposes a short title on device.
features.reason: Nice to have; research lists Foundation Models for Scan titles.

features.name: ID card on one page
features.description: Front and back of a card on one A4 page.

features.name: Import from Photos and Files
features.description: PhotosPicker (no library permission) and file importer for images/PDFs.

features.name: iCloud Drive folder (opt-in)
features.description: Store the archive in the app's iCloud Drive container, off by default (ADR-0008).
features.reason: Replaces cloud upload without a server.

features.name: PDF password
features.description: Encrypt a PDF with a password via PDFKit write options.

screens.name: Archive
elements: List .insetGrouped of folders and PDFs (thumbnail, title, pages, date)

screens.name: Document
screens.purpose: Read and act on one PDF.

flows.name: Scan and send
steps: Save → PDF written with OCR layer

fields.name: url
fields.note: PDF file in Documents/ or a subfolder; the file is the truth

fields.name: text
fields.note: cache rebuilt from the PDF text layer

data_model.storage: PDF files in the app's Documents folder (UIFileSharingEnabled, LSSupportsOpeningDocumentsInPlace), listed by reading the folder; no database (ADR-0006). Optional iCloud Drive container, off by default (ADR-0008).

monetization.model: Ad-supported free tier + Premium subscription (weekly, monthly, quarterly, annual) with trial
monetization.price: Not in the lookup; reviews cite $20.99/year, about $60/year, 39 EUR/year
paywalled_features: Saving or sending as PDF (per several reviews)
monetization.notes: Ads interrupt every step (open, capture, save, send), close buttons hidden; paying users still see ads or lose purchases after updates.

system_frameworks.name: Vision RecognizeDocumentsRequest
system_frameworks.use: Structured text (paragraphs, tables) for better OCR layer; fallback VNRecognizeTextRequest

system_frameworks.name: PDFKit
system_frameworks.use: Write PDF with text layer, merge/split, reorder, password, PDFView

system_frameworks.name: Foundation Models
system_frameworks.use: Suggested document title on device; fallback date + first OCR line

review_risks.risk: Sbu Scanner (QR) is live and 'Sbu Scan' would read as a duplicate; Sbu PDF (GoodReader) is queued for wave 3.
review_risks.mitigation: Ship as Sbu Docs, never 'Sbu Scan'; review notes state how it differs from Scanner (QR codes) and PDF (reading/annotating); no QR, no annotation suite.

review_risks.risk: Notes and Files already scan documents for free; a thin wrapper is a 'variant' of a system feature.
review_risks.mitigation: Differentiate on searchable OCR archive in Files, merge/split, signature, filters; describe this first in the description.
No CamScanner names, layouts or icons; native List and system camera UI; metadata without third-party names.

review_risks.risk: Camera permission and document contents (IDs, contracts).
review_risks.mitigation: Camera string tied to the Scan button, asked on first scan; PhotosPicker needs no library permission; privacy label 'no data collected'.

review_risks.risk: Import from Photos must work with limited/denied access.
review_risks.mitigation: PhotosPicker only, out-of-process, no PHPhotoLibrary authorisation.

review_risks.risk: Must not look like Files or Notes scanner.
review_risks.mitigation: SbuKit design; system camera is allowed as system UI.

review_risks.risk: iOS 26 APIs (Foundation Models, RecognizeDocumentsRequest) on an iOS 17 target.
review_risks.mitigation: if #available with fallbacks; Foundation Models availability checked (device eligibility, Apple Intelligence off).

source.reviews: research/scan/reviews.json: 146 reviews 1-3 stars (US 82, IT 64), each classified by hand
